stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.sub: The three nuclear powers meet at APEC in Shenzhen; arms control and the Iran war top the agenda.

stories.headline: GTA VI arrives after a 13-year wait
stories.sub: Unlocks at midnight in each country. New Zealand first; 15.9m pre-orders banked.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts in the biggest IPO on record
stories.sub: Priced at $83, above its range, the Claude maker raised $81.3bn and is valued near $1.5tn.

stories.headline: Crimean Bridge hit again
stories.sub: Third attack halts traffic; the crossing is closed.

stories.headline: Akvan bears down as 200,000 flee the coast
stories.sub: Red alerts in 11 districts; landfall near Puri due Friday.

stories.headline: Left off the agenda, Ukraine watches Shenzhen

stories.headline: EU approves Indonesia trade pact

stories.headline: Istanbul floods kill three

stories.headline: Libya seizes a mountain of pills
